findings.title: Best previously qualified result retention lacks a production population path and a nonempty acceptance test
findings.evidence: best_accepted_artifact_ref is only initialized to null in the reviewed source. The formal three failed iterations produce no artifact; C16-02 checks counts/deferred status/null task acceptance and records an empty retained artifact array, so this cannot establish retention of a pre-existing qualified result.
findings.required_positive_case: Obtain a real independent acceptance of an artifact tied to the same origin_problem/candidate/input key; follow with three no-progress iterations; preserve the accepted artifact reference, immutable bytes and explicit recovery conditions without promoting failed later attempts.
findings.required_negative_boundary: Unaccepted or self-authored/self-approved output cannot become or replace the qualified best result.
findings.not_claimed: No artifact deletion was observed. The gap is missing population/identification and nonempty retention proof, not an observed destructive loss.

G01_reason: Frozen task gate explicitly requires all C11/C13/C14/C15/C16 assertions, so C16-02 prevents a complete gate pass despite all24 registered checks passing.

readiness.conclusion: Bounded fixture readiness mitigation was exercised; underlying connection timeouts still occurred and their cause remains unconfirmed. Business forwarding code has one explicit Do call; failed complete business mutations were not retried.

scope: Fresh GLOBAL audit and archived raw reconstruction only; previous independent budget/recovery/route/counter matrices retained without needless rerun; no external model/tool qualification calls.
